skill.help.stats: Effectiveness of each skill: runs it took part in, turns, tool calls and cost per run against the baseline of every run
skill.stats.header: Skill effectiveness (per run, against the baseline of every run)
skill.stats.empty: No run has used a skill yet. Stats accumulate as agent and coder runs activate skills.
skill.stats.baseline: baseline · %d runs · %s turns · %s tool calls · %s · %s errors
skill.stats.legend: Percentages in parentheses are the skill's average against the baseline: negative means the runs that used it were shorter or cheaper. A learned skill that stays positive is a candidate for pruning.
